name: n019_voc90_res05
purpose: Targeted WER check using the d5 step-90000 checkpoint, which had the lowest WER among the correct 40-speaker development snapshots, under the current residual0.5 + duration0.5 recipe.
decision_rule: Advance only if WER improves materially toward 7.41% while UTMOS/WhiSQA remain near 3.63/3.69 and W-NT L stays near the current 41.801%. A passing screen still requires a fresh matching LS360 E-VPC S run.
decision: Rejected at the WER gate. The step-90000 checkpoint did not transfer its development WER advantage to the new residual0.5+duration0.5 candidate; full-test WER worsened by 0.0599 pp versus the current soup. UTMOS/WhiSQA and W-NT scoring were stopped to save Card-hours.
